# Interior audio and speaker upgrades

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove interior trim and harnesses, then connect new speaker wires to replace factory units. [t1858]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the left elbow rest piece.
2. Take out the trim located under the elbow rest.
3. Release the clip inside the elbow rest area.
4. Pop off the clip near the door opener handle.
5. Use a flathead screwdriver to remove the pillar clip at the A-pillar.
6. Pry off the panel surrounding the door handle, being careful not to break it.
7. Undo the edge clips holding the panels in place.
8. Unplug the harness for the door lock and window controls on the driver side.
9. [Partial] Disconnect both the brown (door lock) and white (window) wires from the passenger side harness.
10. Remove the four screws securing the speaker to the panel.
11. [Partial] Cut off the existing factory connector if it does not fit the new speaker.
12. [Partial] Crimp a black wire with a white stripe onto one end for negative connection.
13. Crimp a blue wire onto the other end of that same harness for positive connection on the driver side.
14. Connect a red wire and a black wire together to form the passenger side negative lead.
15. Attach a brown wire to complete the passenger side positive lead.
16. Hook up the new speaker wires to test functionality before fully securing it.
17. Screw the speaker back into place once the electrical connection is verified.

_Procedure reported by [t1858]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-front-speaker-replacement-6-5.2165/>_
